title: Job
description: A unit of work explicitly bound to a project. project_id is mandatory: a worker must never modify another project's Blender file (see .kiro/steering/security.md). Identifiers must be non-blank, hence the `\S` pattern alongside minLength.

type.description: Job types supported by the platform. Extend as new operations land.

result.description: Operation-specific result payload. Unconstrained at the contract level.
